40721282.study_design: Retrospective multi-cohort model development with independent external validation using public datasets

40907040.exclusion_reason: Phonocardiogram (heart-sound audio) based deep learning for Still's murmur identification; non-radiologic acoustic signal, not imaging

35118910.model_family: segmentation algorithm (Anchor Based Link, classical image segmentation)
35118910.clinical_problem: Detecting Turner syndrome in girls from hand x-ray by segmenting and measuring the fourth metacarpal bone
35118910.patient_population: 50 sample hand x-ray images of children (normal and Turner syndrome)
35118910.model_description: An Anchor Based Link (ABL) image-segmentation algorithm that segments the fourth metacarpal bone on hand radiographs and uses its height-to-width ratio to help detect Turner syndrome, compared against watershed and GMM-HMRF segmentation methods.
35118910.study_design: Retrospective algorithm development and comparison study

35173593.model_family: machine learning (multivariate lesion- and connectome-based models, planned)
35173593.clinical_problem: Predicting communication impairment at school entry in children with bilateral cerebral palsy from early brain MRI
35173593.patient_population: 178 children with bilateral cerebral palsy across four Chinese hospitals (planned)
35173593.model_description: Planned multivariate lesion- and connectome-based machine learning models that will use features extracted from early brain MRI (before age 2) to predict later communication impairment, trained on 3/4 of the cohort and externally validated on the remaining 1/4.
35173593.study_design: Study protocol for a multicenter prospective cohort study (machine learning model not yet developed/reported)

35324636.model_family: K-nearest neighbors (with texture/fractal features), compared to SVM
35324636.clinical_problem: Detecting placental microcalcifications on ultrasound that may indicate placental dysfunction affecting the fetus
35324636.model_description: A texture-analysis pipeline that computes first- and second-order statistical features (GLCM) and fractal dimension from placental ultrasound, then classifies microcalcification presence using a K-nearest-neighbors classifier (compared with SVM).

35411748.clinical_problem: Reviewing how radiomics can characterize tumor differentiation, staging, and behavior in abdominal tumors, with a look toward application in pediatric abdominal neuroblastoma
35411748.model_description: Narrative review of radiomics technical principles and its use in abdominal tumor precision medicine, discussing prospects for applying radiomics to pediatric abdominal neuroblastoma.

35505108.clinical_problem: Automatically counting radiopaque markers on abdominal radiographs to determine colonic transit time for work-up of pediatric constipation
35505108.patient_population: 436 abdominal radiographs from children at a tertiary children's hospital
35505108.model_description: A convolutional neural network trained to output a density map estimating the location and number of radiopaque markers on abdominal radiographs, replacing manual counting for colonic transit studies.
35505108.headline_result: Mean absolute error 2.6 markers; RMSE 3.9 markers (test set)
35505108.study_design: Retrospective single-center model development and validation study

35603368.clinical_problem: Prenatal prediction of placenta accreta spectrum disorder from MRI
35603368.patient_population: Constructed dataset of prenatal MRI (T1WI/T2WI) with and without PAS
35603368.model_description: A dual-path neural network with a multi-head attention module that fuses features from T1-weighted and T2-weighted MRI sequences to predict placenta accreta spectrum disorder.
35603368.headline_result: Accuracy 88.6%, F1-score 89.9% on independent validation set
35603368.study_design: Retrospective model development and internal validation study

35864986.model_family: CNN (BrainNetCNN) with graph empirical mode decomposition data augmentation
35864986.clinical_problem: Distinguishing gifted children from normal controls using structural brain connectivity derived from MRI
35864986.patient_population: Gifted children and normal control children (MRI dataset)
35864986.model_description: A data augmentation method (graph empirical mode decomposition, GEMD) that generates artificial structural-connectivity training samples, used with a deep neural network (BrainNetCNN) to classify gifted versus normal children's brain MRI connectomes.
35864986.headline_result: Classification accuracy improved from 55.7% to 78% (up to 93.3% in some cases) with GEMD augmentation

35909473.clinical_problem: Classifying chest radiographs as normal, bacterial pneumonia, or viral pneumonia in pediatric patients
35909473.patient_population: Pediatric chest x-rays from an open Kaggle database
35909473.model_description: A CNN trained on a public pediatric chest x-ray dataset (Kaggle) with data augmentation to classify images as normal, bacterial pneumonia, or viral pneumonia, deployed via a web application.
35909473.study_design: Retrospective model development study using a public dataset; NOTE: this publication has been retracted

35922049.clinical_problem: Predicting fatty liver (hepatic steatosis) in obese children using clinical and ultrasound-derived measurements
35922049.model_description: Machine learning models (CatBoost feature selection, logistic regression and CatBoost classifiers) that take clinical and ultrasound-derived features (BMI, height, liver size, kidney volume, glomerular filtration rate, liver diameter) as input and predict probability of fatty liver in children.
35922049.headline_result: Predicted mean probability of fatty liver 74.47-92.22% in severely obese, 73.45-85.41% in obese children
35922049.study_design: Retrospective model development and comparison study

36057759.exclusion_reason: Animal (fetal sheep) study of needle-tracking ultrasound image enhancement; not human pediatric imaging

36085753.clinical_problem: Diagnosing tuberous sclerosis complex in children from multi-contrast brain MRI
36085753.model_description: Two 3D CNNs combined via late fusion, using a novel combined T2w/FLAIR contrast (FLAIR3) alongside standard sequences, to classify pediatric brain MRI as tuberous sclerosis complex versus healthy.
36085753.study_design: Retrospective model development and internal validation study

36086576.clinical_problem: Predicting sex and identifying sex-related brain structural changes in adolescents using longitudinal structural MRI (ABCD study)
36086576.patient_population: Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study participants
36086576.model_description: A 3D deep learning model trained on structural MRI from the ABCD study to predict participant sex and visualize the brain regions (frontal, temporal, and with age, visual/cingulate/insular) driving that prediction.
36086576.dataset_size: ABCD study cohort (subset; n not stated in abstract)
36086576.study_design: Retrospective longitudinal deep-learning analysis using a multi-site cohort (ABCD study)

36270101.clinical_problem: Predicting resting-state canonical brain network connectivity (e.g., default mode network) from task-based fMRI co-activation patterns during development
36270101.patient_population: ABCD study: 6,073 youth at baseline (age 10.0+/-0.6y), 3,539 at 2-year follow-up (age 11.9+/-0.6y)
36270101.model_description: A cross-validated activation-based predictive modeling (machine learning) approach that uses multi-task fMRI co-activation matrices to predict resting-state functional connectivity within canonical brain networks (e.g., default mode network) at baseline and two years later.
36270101.headline_result: DMN connectivity prediction rho=0.179 (baseline, p<0.001); rho=0.258 predicting 2-year follow-up DMN connectivity
36270101.study_design: Prospective longitudinal cohort study (ABCD) with cross-validated machine-learning prediction analysis

38352916.exclusion_reason: Describes a data-sharing repository platform for dyslexia neuroimaging research, not a specific pediatric radiology AI model or clinical study

38903074.clinical_problem: Detecting congenital heart disease on second-trimester fetal anomaly-scan ultrasound images in a community (low-risk population) setting
38903074.patient_population: 42 normal fetuses and 66 fetuses with isolated severe CHD at birth, Netherlands 2015-2016
38903074.model_description: A previously trained deep learning model, originally developed on tertiary-center images, applied to fetal cardiac ultrasound images from a community second-trimester anomaly scan to classify normal versus congenital heart disease.
38903074.headline_result: Model sensitivity 91%, specificity 93%, vs clinical detection sensitivity 53%; blinded experts sensitivity 55+/-10%, specificity 71+/-13%
38903074.study_design: Retrospective external validation study in a community low-risk population (preprint, medRxiv)

39021439.clinical_problem: Classifying autism spectrum disorder from resting-state fMRI as an objective, quantifiable complement to clinical behavioral diagnosis
39021439.model_description: A deep learning framework that converts fMRI regional time-series into Gramian Angular Field images, extracts features with a CNN, models inter-regional temporal dynamics with an LSTM, and classifies ASD versus neurotypical brains with a final perceptron layer.
39021439.headline_result: Maximum accuracy 81.78%; outperformed prior state-of-the-art by 17.58% and 6.7% at two centers
39021439.study_design: Retrospective model development and multi-center benchmark evaluation using public dataset
